text:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: GPU pool 'hotpath-us-west-2' at 100% capacity, queue depth spike, returning 429s for tiered rate policies. Autoscales failing with "scale_limit_reached" in last 60s. Paging on-call: @irene

irene: on it. seeing alert. where's the customer impact? metrics?

michael: I'm seeing 429s climbing from 0.2% -> 9% in 3m for hosted API keys on 'prod' routes. Avg latency for non-429 requests also up from 120ms -> 420ms.

anya: confirmed. Hotpool GPU utilization 100%, hotpool queue length ~ 12k. Autoscaler logs show backfill failures and a hard cap at 24 nodes (quota).

kyle: autoscaler hitting cluster-wide gpus_quota limit, `ScaleDecision: max_nodes_reached`. We hit a soft tokenbucket tiering threshold that prevents larger bursts from higher tiers. Tokenbucket refill rate looks misaligned after the last policy change.

irene: priority: mitigate customer-facing 429s first. options: 1) loosen tokenbucket for high-tier keys temporarily, 2) route traffic to lower-cost model variants (smaller) for non-critical routes, 3) emergency scale request to infra. Any quick wins?

michael: quickest is tokenbucket tweak. If we increase burst and refill for tier 'prod-high' from 2000->5000 tokens and bump per-second refill by 2x, we should absorb current surge for ~5-10m while we scale.

anya: risky if sustained — will increase cost, but good for immediate relief. Also can flip policy to allow fallback to 'gpt-small' for routes with scoring <0.7. That reduces GPU pressure.

eng-runtime-oncall: FYI autoscaler team: quota is project-level. You can request emergency quota from infra but that takes ~15-30m. We can also temporarily mark a few dedicated pools as available to hosted via routing maps.

kyle: I'll prepare a hotpatch for tokenbucket. Command: 
```bash
redwoodctl ratepolicy update --tier prod-high --burst 5000 --refill 2x --reason "hotpatch - absorb surge"
```
I'll also add a rollback window of 20m.

irene: do it. add a note in case we see abuse. notify customers on impacted SLAs.

sre-bot: Action taken: ratepolicy updated for prod-high (burst=5000, refill=2x). Deploy id: dp-7893. Timestamp 2538246078. :white_check_mark:

michael: immediate effect: 429s drop from 9% -> 1.6% within 45s. latency back to ~210ms. Queue length trending down.

anya: starting gradual routing fallback: non-critical routes -> gpt-small (canary 10%). Will monitor hallucination/quality regression.

eng-runtime-oncall: I'm opening a high-priority ticket to review tokenbucket defaults and tier-mismatch rules. Autoscaler cap needs addressing — we should put a temporary policy that allows borrowing from dedicated pools when quota reached.

irene: good. postmortem owners: eng-runtime (root cause: autoscaler quota + tokenbucket mis-tune) and product ops (customer impact comms). Action items: 1) request quota increase, 2) revert tokenbucket to prior values after surge (scheduled), 3) add automated fallback routing in policy, 4) run a chaos test to validate tokenbucket and autoscale interaction.

kyle: putting the rollback in 20m: `redwoodctl ratepolicy rollback --deploy dp-7893 --after 20m` unless we extend.

michael: customer comms draft: "We observed higher than normal request surge that caused temporary capacity exhaustion leading to elevated 429s and latency. We applied a temporary ratepolicy change and routing fallback to reduce customer impact. We're investigating and will follow up with permanent fixes."

irene: tagging SRE/eng-runtime for follow-up. Leaving the channel open for 1h for monitoring. If 429s remain >1% escalate to infra-ops.

sre-bot: Monitoring: 20m window started at 2538246078. Current 429s 1.4%, hotpool util 88%.

kyle: note for the postmortem: config diff shows last change to ratepolicy for prod-high 2d ago (PR #4121) where burst was reduced from 5000->2000 to curb abuse. That change combined with sustained user burst is the proximate config mismatch.

anya: capturing screenshots and metrics for the RCA. Will include sample request IDs showing 429s: `req_ji8f2`, `req_t4k3e`.

eng-runtime-oncall: I'll own the follow-up ticket, cc infra for quota request. Great job on the quick mitigation.

irene: thanks team. I'll close this incident channel once postmortem is filed and customers notified. :thumbsup:
